push.title: D 2-2 vs FC Creamsters | You: 8.3 (best match performance)
push.body:
Your best match performance, BellyTb1: an 8.3. You're cooking with gas.

THE GOOD
+ 30 passes. You were the hub of the wheel.
+ 2 key passes. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ A goal against FC Creamsters, your 3rd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ Man of the Match. When you play like that, the whole team stands taller.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.

THE BAD
- 6 shots off target shaved 0.2 off. Clean that up and you're flying.
- 2 missed tackles: -0.1. Easy points to win back.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. You're knocking on the 87%+ door.

Work on: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Remember, BellyTb1: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

Hold onto this feeling. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.5 is your 2nd best match performance. Middle of your road, heading the right way.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ You and BellyTb1 turned simple passes into goals.
+ 7.5, your 2nd best match performance. Bottle it.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (31 vs their best 17). That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. Like finding a twenty in last winter's coat.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Low-hanging fruit: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. Steady does it.
- Worst assists of your 3 matches this session (0). That needs to look different next time out.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 88%+ is something else.
- Tackles attempted 4, from 7 in your previous match. It happens. It can't keep happening.

Five minutes of this: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Better days are booked. - Coach Lasso
